resources.string: Covers the Instagram Reels icon and the YouTube Shorts icon in the bottom bar. Feed posts stay visible. When a Reel or Short is open, a finger swipe presses the system back button. Reclaim reads on-screen controls and does not look at URLs.
Reclaim is on. It acts while Instagram or YouTube is in front.
Reclaim is off. Turn it on in Android accessibility settings.

Reclaim covers the Reels icon and the Shorts icon in the bottom bar. Reels and Shorts that appear in the feed stay visible. When a Reel or Short is open, a finger swipe presses the system back button, which returns to the previous screen, such as the chat. A tap still reaches the video.
